An explicit justification for a term local name that the primary/preferred/default/main naming lint (CONSTITUTION P9, co-equal facet lint) would otherwise reject. Legitimate value-vocabulary uses exist — [`gmeow:scriptRolePrimary`](../individuals/gmeow-scriptRolePrimary.md) names a linguistic reality (one co-equal value among seven), [`gmeow:sourceTierPrimary`](../individuals/gmeow-sourceTierPrimary.md) is the standard bibliographic axis — and this annotation records that judgment so the lint enforces it instead of relying on audit-time discretion. A term carrying [`namingNote`](gmeow-namingNote.md) must still never be a selector that privileges one co-equal claim over another.
